title: Induction Service Tools for Mercedes V6 & V8 engines
lead: MOC has developed 2 new adapters (Part No. 72166 and 72167) for use with the Deluxe Induction Tool (Part No. 72172) when performing an induction service on certain Mercedes vehicles.
body: Part No. 72166, for the V6 twin turbo (276 engines), connects at the vacuum hose.
Part No. 72167, for the V8 turbo (278 engines), connects at the temp sensor.
